title: CITITRENDS Announces Finance Leadership Update
summary: SAVANNAH, Ga., September 11, 2026--Citi Trends, Inc. (NASDAQ: CTRN), a leading off-price value retailer of apparel, accessories and home trends primarily for Black families, today announced that Chief Financial Officer Heather Plutino has informed the Company of her decision to step down from her role for personal reasons.
